summary: Verified all 4 changes (rater swap + startup validator, ownership stamping, owner-filtered reads/writes, automatic anon session id) plus anonymous/signed-in build regressions. 49/50 backend tests pass. Two real defects found: (1) POST /api/chains/{id}/workspace/{gen} is the only chain endpoint that was NOT owner-filtered — a non-owner gets 200 and the victim's file listing + files materialized to /workspaces (security leak, FIX #3 gap). (2) The new rater slug openai/gpt-3.5-turbo parrots the zero-filled JSON template in SYSTEM_RATER, so every build now scores 0.0 on all 5 dims and composite_score = -0.1 (reproduced 3/3 direct calls + 3/3 real builds) — the startup validator passes because it only checks that the model responds, not that scores are meaningful.

critical.issue: No owner filter (server.py:707-747 queries db.chains.find_one({'id': chain_id}) only). Verified with curl: intruder session got 200 with {'workspace_path','files':['index.html','run.sh','README.md']} for a chain owned by 'regression-owner', and the victim's files were re-materialized to /workspaces. Must accept `request: Request` and use `_owner_filter`, returning 404 'chain not found'.

Rater returns the literal example JSON from SYSTEM_RATER ('{"helpfulness":0.0,...,"verbosity":0.0}') verbatim. 3/3 direct probes and 3/3 full builds produced all-zero rewards -> composite_score -0.1 shown in the UI with empty score bars. Breaks the recursive exemplar-ranking loop (verified-chain scoring). Fix: use a stronger primary rater (e.g. openai/gpt-4o-mini, currently only the fallback), remove the all-zeros literal from the prompt, and treat an all-zero/degenerate response as invalid so rate_step falls back to the deterministic started-based score.

minor.issue: 'CHAINS :: 26' badge is a global, cross-tenant chain count rendered to every anonymous visitor. Not a prompt leak, but it is not owner-scoped like everything else — confirm this is intentional.

Model assignments are still resolved from db.settings using the body-level req.session_id only, so a signed-in user who sends no body session_id always gets DEFAULT_ASSIGNMENTS (BYOK/model prefs are not honoured on the auth path).

issues: All five reward bars render empty and COMPOSITE shows -0.100 for every build (downstream of the rater defect); a negative composite is also displayed without any indication that scoring failed

action_items: Add owner filtering to POST /api/chains/{id}/workspace/{gen} (only unprotected chain endpoint left)
Fix rater scoring: swap primary rater to a stronger model, drop the all-zeros literal from SYSTEM_RATER, and reject degenerate all-zero score payloads in rate_step()
Make _validate_default_rater assert a non-degenerate score (e.g. sum > 0) instead of just a 200 response
Optionally resolve model assignments/BYOK from the resolved owner (user_id) instead of body session_id only
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:707 open_in_vscode lacks `request: Request` + `_owner_filter` — inconsistent with the other 8 endpoints and leaks another owner's file tree.
_owner_filter's no-identity sentinel {'_id': '__no_owner__'} works but relies on Mongo type mismatch; a clearly-impossible filter such as {'id': {'$in': []}} is safer and index-friendly.
chain_generator.rate_step treats a parsed-but-empty/zeroed payload as valid (`if not data` only), so the deterministic fallback never triggers for a model that echoes the template.
server.py is 1024 lines — consider splitting routers (chains, auth, settings, github) into modules.

rca_of_the_issue: Workspace leak: open_in_vscode was missed when _owner_filter was applied to the other endpoints; it still queries by chain id alone. Rater zeros: SYSTEM_RATER embeds a fully zero-filled JSON example and gpt-3.5-turbo (weak instruction-following) echoes it at temperature 0.1; _extract_json succeeds so rate_step's `if not data` fallback never fires, and composite() computes 0.35*0+...-0.05*|0-2| = -0.1.
